'''Team Oversight''' was the name given to three members of [[Wraith Squadron]], a [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit, during their [[Mission to Kuratooine|mission]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kuratooine]] to prove Galactic Alliance [[Galactic Alliance Army|Army]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Stavin Thaal]]'s corruption<ref name="MK" /> in [[44 ABY]].<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> [[Wran Narcassan]], [[Thaymes Fodrick]], and [[Viull Gorsat]], were assigned to oversee various aspects of the mission, with Gorsat's civilian father, [[Mulus Cheems]], joining the team as a last minute addition.<ref name="MK" />

Fodrick drove a delivery [[Airspeeder/Legends|speeder]] to pick up [[Team Shellfish]], which consisted of [[Huhunna]], [[Jesmin Tainer]], and [[Turman Durra]] after their escape from [[Chakham Army Base]]. Inside the speeder, Durra changed into his disguise as [[Ton Phanan]], a long [[Death/Legends|deceased]] Wraith whom they were using as part of their ruse, with a [[neoglith masquer]]. Meanwhile, Fodrick monitored the communication relays he had set up for the Wraiths' broadcast without being traced by Thaal's men.<ref name="MK" />

Narcassan took a position on a building with his [[Sniper rifle/Legends|sniper rifle]] to guard against [[Pop-Dogs]] reinforcements, an elite Alliance army unit commanded by Thaal, from reaching him. He successfully disable two of the four speeders carrying Pop-Dog troopers.<ref name="MK" />

Gorsat was tasked with creating a replacement [[scapedroid]] after the one the Wraiths had rented became unavailable. The droid would later approach Thaal while projecting a recording of Durra, disguised as Phanan, accusing Thaal of being an impostor.<ref name="MK" />

Cheems, meanwhile, monitored the tent the Wraiths had set up at the open market to serve as their main operations room. The tent housed their disguises for the next phase of the mission and served as the location where they changed.<ref name="MK" />
